technique_name: Describe the historic events that led to the formation of the United Nations.
description: The United Nations was established in 1945, at the conclusion of World War II. Its founders were determined to prevent future wars by promoting collective security, respecting one another's sovereignty, and promoting economic progress. Its founding document, The Charter of the United Nations, laid out a vision for a peace-keeping organization dedicated to meditating international disputes and promoting global cooperation.
